column1: # CHAOS-13833: the measured top-level tests of the race split packages of ci/go_race_splits.tsv: package<TAB>TestName<TAB>seconds.
# A race leg cuts a split package's names into its parts by these rows (ci/go_race_shard.awk cut(), the cutter of the test legs): a
# measured name longest first onto the lightest part; a listed name with no row goes to the LAST part (restpart), never dropped,
# and a top-level test of 30 s or more with no row fails its race leg (ci/go_race_unweighted_slow.awk).
# Value rule (CHAOS-8135, as ci/go_race_weights.d): the largest hosted race-leg elapsed of the test (go-test-timings-race-K-of-N
# artifacts), rounded up, at least 1. Every top-level test the -race listing reports has a row (internal/cigates/testshard pins it).
# A test added with its row before any hosted race run measured it takes its local race time, rounded up (the 5 race-split cells: 1-2 s).
# internal/cigates/testshard: the race-1-of-6 artifacts of main push runs 43659268009, 43662511162, 43663384548, 43664577954,
